thread:
zara: Quick heads-up — I'm rewriting the Starter Launch quickstart to match the new auth header flow (scoped tokens + rotation) and to add a tiny Docker-first-deploy section. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482  

zara: Outline I pushed in the PR description: 1) auth primer, 2) minimal SDK snippet (node/python), 3) Dockerfile + run instructions, 4) troubleshooting + common errors. Need tech review + copy edit. @marco @jen :eyes:

marco: taking a look now. main thing — call out which token types work with hosted vs private (scoped vs account-wide). also add example env var names so people don't copy the wrong var.

jen: agree with marco. for Docker section, add note about not committing `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and show `--build-arg` or `ARG` usage. quick snippet: 

```Dockerfile
ARG REDWOOD_API_KEY
ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY}
# later: CMD ["node","index.js"]
```

alex: I'll update the Node SDK snippet to the new `client.auth.setToken()` pattern and include a one-liner cURL example. leaving a comment on the PR for exact lines to change.

zara: thanks. also want to add a brief migration note for teams coming from the older `x-api-key` style — one paragraph and a code diff should suffice.

marco: small nit — use `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` (singular) in examples, we standardised on that in the console last month. file perms note: recommend `chmod 600` when storing local creds.

jen: new Docker example LGTM but add step to expose port 8000 (some new starters expect 3000). suggest: `EXPOSE 8000`.

alex: proposed Node snippet (from my local test):

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ baseUrl: process.env.REDWOOD_API_URL });
client.auth.setToken(process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN);
const res = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood/mini', input: 'hello' });
console.log(res.output[0].text);
```

alex: will push that into the PR under `docs/quickstarts/starter-launch.md` unless there are objections.

marco: no objections. can you also add a single-line example for private deployment (VPC) — basically the same but point `REDWOOD_API_URL` at the private control plane host.

zara: yes please. also adding a short troubleshooting table: auth errors, 401 vs 403, token scopes.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood-inference.com/quickstarts/starter-launch

jen: checking the preview now — saw a small formatting thing where the Dockerfile block lost leading spaces. I'll push a formatting fix.

zara: awesome. timeline: if we can get reviews + edits by EOD tomorrow I'll merge, then notify engineering blog for a short blurb in the onboarding mailer.

alex: ping me when it's merged, I'll update the SDK sample repo to point to the new quickstart link. :shipit:

marco: added a checklist comment on the PR for me/jen/alex to tick off.

zara: thanks team — leaving branch open for small fixes, will merge after checks. :thumbsup:
